body:
(I am appealing for RageKaos)
  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) RageKaos
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned Advertising
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. I'm sorry You might not believe this but my young brother was on and doing stuff I told him not to do. I that he was responisble with my account but I do wrong. This is my account, my account my responsibility. I'm sorry for the actions that happened on this account and hope you give me a last chance. I will protect my account and change my pass.
  • I was banned on June 16, 2015 by Flyo.
  • Yes I am evading on this account Niqhtwinq because it wasn't me who advertised.
  • I NEVER appealed before, and never wanted to in the first place.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

seeing as you are using multiple accounts to connect to the server while banned, you appeal is automatically denied.

If you wanted to make an appeal, you should have done so before ban evading with multiple accounts.

You will not be appealed.
